metrics: Designers Resource Textile Pvt Ltd, an Indian home textile leader, addressed challenges in order fulfillment and remote work during the pandemic by adopting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
Results include a 15 percent operational cost reduction and a 20 percent sales increase.
Additionally, sales declined due to the pandemic-induced lockdowns and economic uncertainties, which prompted the company to look at strategic cost-reduction measures.
The transition to remote work for most employees during the pandemic presented new challenges in day-to-day operations running on the erstwhile on-prem solution.

Moving to the cloud with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central After assessing many different applications, Designers Resource concluded that Microsoft's cloud offering presented the most comprehensive solution to its business requirements.
Therefore, the company decided to deploy Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central on the cloud.

Navin Sankhala, General Manager, Designers Resource, says, “Along with Microsoft partner, Krizzan Consulting Private Limited, we mapped our business processes to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and moved them to the cloud.
The deployment process was smooth and was completed in just 45 days.
